responsibility: Declares the generated hidden-type parser entry point for gm2. Its `CompilationUnit` routine runs the special pass dedicated to resolving hidden types while still using the front end’s standard error-recovering grammar framework.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file for the hidden-type parser pass, exporting CompilationUnit only; unlike PHBuild.bnf, it does not define the grammar productions or semantic actions for that pass.
